items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 9 at 1:37PM EDT until October 11 at 6:00AM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and seas 5
to 8 ft expected.

* WHERE...Southeast North Carolina and Northeast South Carolina
coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...From 8 AM Saturday to 6 AM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
